newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-April copper exports up 115.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-April copper exports up 115.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's exports of unwrought copper and copper materials totalled 58,496 tonnes in January-April, up 115.6 percent from the same year-ago period, customs figures showed on Wednesday.
Exports in April alone were 13,494 tonnes. There were no comparative figures for the month.
Exports of unwrought copper including alloys rose by a year-on-year 229.1 percent in the first four months to 31,932 tonnes, the figures showed. Exports for April alone were 5,872 tonnes.

China's imports of unwrought copper and copper materials reached 195,978 tonnes in the first four months, up 14.2 percent compared with the year-ago period. Imports for April alone were 61,228 tonnes.

Imports of unwrought copper including alloys were 54,148 tonnes in the first four months, a drop of 12 percent compared with the same period in 1996 and imports for April alone were 18,649 tonnes. --Beijing Newsroom (8610) 6532-1921
